title: Design typed-edge schema for memory relationships
description:
## G-4 (from kb-graph-rag-audit)

MaintenanceTopicMapService.ExtractTagRelationships already parses relation semantics out of Tags today: tags of shape `supersedes:tsk-0123`, `depends-on:xyz`, `conflicts-with:abc` are interpreted as typed graph edges. This is undocumented, not validated against real record IDs, and means the same string field (Tags) is simultaneously subject to tag-policy governance and silently double-duty as relationship storage.

### Detailed Steps
1. Define new edge shape: sourceId, targetId, relationType (closed vocabulary: references, supersedes, depends_on, conflicts_with, same_as, mentions — extending what MaintenanceTopicMapService already uses), origin (manual/inferred/imported), createdAtUtc
2. Keep References/Conflicts as-is for backward compatibility (RRF scorer reads record.References directly for referenceTokens — C1)
3. Ensure additive alongside existing References/Conflicts arrays (no breaking migration)

### Test Plan
- Schema validation test (design review)
- Compatibility test: existing References/Conflicts data survives migration unmodified
